notes:
Passed on the fake backend only (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level); no hardware backend is declared and no hardware was attached. The card's family-config/GymnasiumDriver shape matches AllegroRelocateRLEnv (a legacy gym.Env built in-process, example/example_use_state_only_env.py:14-22), so no deviation from the card was needed. NOT COVERED: the real SAPIEN environment was not run or imported (sapien 2.1.0 is not installed where the gate runs; the clone's README.md:37-39 downloads day.ktx and the ShapeNet/EGAD assets are external), and no sim backend is declared because no gym id registers the class. The fake is this package's own kinematic stand-in: it reproduces the interface, the 22-element Box(-1,1) action space of the default robot (6+16, common_robot_utils.py:53-56), the 57-element oracle-state layout and the seeded reset draws, but it has no SAPIEN dynamics, contacts, lift or actuator model and was never compared with an upstream run; the driver's fidelity F0 gaps and fake.py disclose this. The observation array is full length (57), not a reduced array. The action bounds are derived by the gymnasium bridge from the live fake (no hand-written Limit). Expected warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the bridge records the seed for the next reset and makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived integer seed/ticks and the numeric action.values (the Gymnasium family leaves these; the exemplar has the same class of warnings). G4 passed with no REF_VALUE or REF_BINARY warnings. Only the catalogue's cap.world.step/reset/seed classes are used, so there are no catalogue requests. Model-authored (deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017, run wC-058) and unreviewed; no human reviewed or tested it. gate.digest is the digest line the check printed for this run; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
